about: Settings for tools/prefill.mjs (see tools/README.md). Times are HH:MM in timeZone. AI quotas reset at 00:00 UTC = 05:30 IST.

tokens.about: Estimates per AI call (measured 2026-11-19 on Groq gpt-oss-120b: 4.0-5.4k real tokens per hints reply), and per-UTC-day budgets: beforeReset = what the old day may still use before 05:30 IST, afterReset = the new day's share (keep ~20% of the dev key's daily quota).

priority.about: The first `count` problems (Blind 75 → NeetCode 150 → company problems) get only `languages` besides C++, so they finish first.
